notes.title: Before Exit: Gas Station Arrives 10.10.2025
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2][p]While we are 100% focused on polishing our product we have some exciting news to share - [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i] now has an official release date![/p][p][/p][h3]The full version of the game will launch on [b]October 10th, 2025[/b]. 🎉 [/h3][p]To mark this milestone, we’ve prepared a brand-new [b]trailer[/b] that not only announces the release date but also gives you a fresh look at what’s coming.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tJCa-Mg5D30;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It's fully based on in-game gameplay and should give you more insight of what is coming besides just closing the station...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/6e6da3ef8a2de47c04d3ebcfba6bfd8792a25057.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Playtests continues![/h2][p][/p][p]At the same time, our [b]playtests are still ongoing[/b]. We’re carefully reviewing all of the feedback you’ve been sending us, and it’s been incredibly helpful in shaping the game. If you haven’t had a chance to participate yet, it’s not too late - the playtest is still open, and you can join directly from our Steam page.[/p][p]We also want to take a moment to say [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who has already taken part. Your insights, ideas, and time mean a lot to us. We can’t wait to share some of the results of this collaboration with the whole community in the near future.[/p][p]This is a huge step forward for [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i], and we’re thrilled to finally be able to set our sights on the release. The journey continues - and we’re glad to have you with us![/p][p][/p][h3]See you everyone on 10.10! Thanks![/h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/"]

notes.title: Before Exit: Gas Station - Playtest is Live!
notes.content: [h1]Hello everyone,[/h1][h3]The day has finally come - our playtest for [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i] is officially live! 🎉[/h3][p]If you’ve already signed up for the playtest, you should now find [b]“Before Exit: Gas Station Playtest”[/b] waiting for you in your Steam Library. Simply download it and you’re ready to go.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/"][/dynamiclink]We will constantly accept another batches of players down the line, so if you also want to play it - go ahead and request, you should be able to play soon![/p][p]For this test, we’re focusing on [b]a new singleplayer portion of the game[/b]. This version was created specifically for playtesting and is designed to help us evaluate our current direction and the overall feel of the gameplay. It doesn’t represent the full scope or final quality of the game - but your feedback here will be invaluable for shaping the final product.[/p][p]After completing the playtest, we kindly ask you to share your impressions with us through the short feedback form. You can access it directly from the main menu by clicking the [b]“Send Feedback”[/b] button in the bottom-right corner.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/8d795998abf91f8f0e0e749386d0f37d914042fa.png"][/img][i]I really like this bricks scenario tbh even though I hated it at first. Asset is really nice![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for taking the time to play and share your thoughts. Every moment you spend with [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i] helps us make it better. 🚗⛽[/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/6ab5374082ef97ff5eeabc0b80ca4e7c1008480a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest requests are now open!
notes.content: [h2][b]Hello dear players,[/b][/h2][p]Over the past few months, we’ve been working tirelessly on polishing our game — improving the elements we originally presented in the demo and expanding the production with multiplayer and new scenarios.[/p][p]However, we’re not entirely sure if the direction we’ve taken is truly the right one. Of course, as creators, we like to believe our game is the best in the world, but such a narcissistic, short-sighted approach could prove disappointing in the long run. That’s why we need to ask for your help![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/66bd9e6ff9b4403f86da42c6c1d21fff903ca827.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Help us playtest our game![/b][/h2][h3]On our Steam store page, you’ll now find a button that lets you sign up for the playtests. On [b]Thursday, September 18th[/b], we’ll be letting the first wave of players into the game.[/h3][p][b]For the playtest, we’ve prepared a special build created just for this occasion[/b] - the scenarios included are tailored specifically for this test. After playing, we’ll kindly ask you to fill out a short survey and share your impressions with us. This feedback will really help us shape the final product to make it as enjoyable as possible.[/p][p]We warmly invite you to join the playtest, and we thank you in advance for every moment you spend playing![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/01811694694f84d3a66a291646ec0a0ed7a31ebd.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Before Exit: Gas Station - Multiplayer announcement and project progress!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello again, late-shift survivors![/h2][p]First of all - [b]a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo during Steam Next Fest[/b]. Your support, feedback, streams, videos, and general excitement meant the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]🛠️ [b]So… what’s happening now?[/b] We’ve been hard at work since Steam Next Fest, and today we’re sharing a first look at some [b]new mechanics[/b] coming to [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i] as development continues.[/p][p][/p][h3]💼 [b]Development Continues[/b][/h3][p]Release of Before Exit: Supermarked left us with some mechanics that we didn't have time to implement, but we promised ourselfs that we will do it next time. And guess what? We did it! (at least some part of it). 

🧽 [b]Mirror Cleaning[/b][/p][p]We’ve added a new task that feels oddly personal: cleaning a dirty mirror. It’s more than just a quick wipe – some smudges take a bit more effort, and you might not love what you see staring back.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/b832eb7b0bfb003861bb205fd6f26b3d12af7fe6.png"][/img][/p][p]🔧 [b]Tool Polishing[/b][/p][p]Some tools are old, rusty, and in desperate need of attention – and now it’s your job to make them shine again. Using the grinder, you'll carefully remove rust and restore them to working order. It’s gritty, a little therapeutic… and another reminder that every little task matters when someone’s watching.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/ec71d24780556713a146998f40248b3a551bb6b8.png"][/img][/p][h3]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]And One More Thing… Multiplayer is Coming![/b][/h3][p]From the very beginning - even back in our previous project - we thought of bringing multiplayer into the mix. With the second iteration of [i]Before Exit:[/i], we will try to do it, and to do it right. We’re excited to announce that [b]multiplayer is in development[/b]. Soon, you won’t be finishing your shift alone. You’ll be sharing the responsibility (and the stress) of closing down the gas station [b]together[/b]. Because if there’s one thing scarier than a strict boss... it’s disappointing your teammate while he’s watching, too.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]That’s all for now[/b] - but we’re just getting started. There’s still plenty of work ahead, and we’re incredibly excited about what’s coming next.[/h3][p]🛠️ Thank you for every playthrough, every message, every kind word.[/p][p]Stick with us, follow the game on Steam and social media, and stay tuned for more updates soon. The night shift at [i]Before Exit: Gas Station[/i] is far from over… and it’s about to get a lot more interesting.[/p][p]See you after dark. 🌙⛽[/p][p][/p][p]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/cc0d6f521c573a628fd5f67dda106334a353c602.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Boss Has Had Enough – Are You Ready to Be Fired?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello folks![/h2]

In [i][b]Before Exit: Gas Station[/b][/i], you’re not just trying to finish your shift - you’re trying to survive it and not get fired.

Your job seems easy at first: clean up the gas station, restock the shelves, close the doors, and send the last customers home. But don’t let the simple tasks fool you. There’s someone who’s always watching, and he’s just waiting for you to make a mistake. That someone is your [b]boss[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/7f41b8c8cbfecf2bcc9b2551b2d38a9cc598c92f.jpg[/img]

The [b]boss[/b] in [i][b]Before Exit: Gas Station[/b][/i] isn’t like bosses in other games or real life. He doesn’t give you a pat on the back when you finish your work. He doesn’t thank you for staying late. Instead, he’s always looking for something to complain about. He’s sharp, impatient, and seems ready to fire you at any moment.

Forget to put the boxes away? You’re in trouble. Didn’t refill the shelves? He’s not happy. Leave a spill on the floor? He’s furious. Even if you think you’ve done everything right, he’ll still find a reason to get mad. Some say he’s just strict, but it almost feels like he wants you to fail.

That’s the real challenge of [i][b]Before Exit: Gas Station[/b][/i]. The creepy forest outside, the strange customers - they’re all scary. But the scariest thing is knowing that your boss is waiting for you to mess up. Every shift feels like a test, and if you fail, you’re out of a job.

And here’s the exciting part: the free demo is already live on Steam! You don’t have to wait to see what it’s like to work under the [b]boss’s[/b] watchful eye. You can download the demo right now and play it for yourself. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a late-shift worker at a gas station where nothing is ever as simple as it seems.

store.steampowered.com/app/3714160/Before_Exit_Gas_Station_Demo/?snr=1_7_7_230_150_1
But the another step related to celebration is coming soon! From June 9 to June 16, [i][b]Before Exit: Gas Station[/b][/i] will be part of [i]Steam Next Fest![/i] During [i]Steam Next Fest[/i], players from all over will be able to try the demo, share their thoughts, and see the direction this project is heading. It’s a big moment for us, and we’re excited to have you join us on this journey.

if you want to talk about the game, share your thoughts, or just hang out with us, join our Discord community server:
[url=https://www.takeitstudio.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/2056ff339bb4bded63172eb0162d727f035fe150.png[/img][/url]

Are you ready and excited to try? Can you handle the pressure of a boss who notices every little thing? Can you make it through the night without getting fired?

The [b]boss[/b] is watching. And he’s ready for you!
[h3]Before Exit: Gas Station Dev Team[/h3]

notes.title: Before Exit: Gas Station – A Demo is Coming for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Welcome back to work! Or… almost.[/h2][/b]
We’ve got something special cooking behind the scenes:
[b]Before Exit: Gas Station[/b] is officially joining [i]Steam Next Fest[/i] — and yes, that means you’ll soon be able to play [b]the demo[/b]! 🚗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/e8365695c3fd1940fad8f18c3a3f053e4c4211bb.png[/img]

In this next chapter of the [b]Before Exit series[/b], you return as your favorite hard-working (and underpaid) employee. This time, your shift takes place at a lonely gas station in the middle of nowhere, and your mission is simple on paper: close up for the night.

[h3]This isn’t just about turning off the lights and locking the doors.[/h3]
You’ll need to clean the floors, restock the shelves, check the fuel pumps, and… politely get rid of the last-minute customers. And don’t forget — your boss is watching. [u]Always[/u]. And he’s not happy unless everything is perfect!

You'll also be able to step outside the workplace before heading home. Inspect the forecourt, clean up oil stains, lock the garage, and make sure nobody’s trying to sneak in for a late fill-up.

Mixing roguelike structure, environmental storytelling, and first-person problem-solving, Before Exit: Gas Station turns the mundane into the mysterious — one night shift at a time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/
